text:
Nina (Saltwind): Heads-up — were running a product showcase for APAC/AP+LAT tomorrow 14:00 SGT. Need a fast pattern: add two CIDRs to allowlist on tokyo edge, set qps=1100 for 10h, and configure a Brazil (sa-east-1) cold-fallback route if tokyo gets overloaded. CIDRs: 198.51.100.16/28 and 203.0.113.64/26. Auto-revoke after window.
Carlos (CS): Cool. Can you confirm UTC start, steady vs peak, and whether the client will use mTLS or header auth? I'll mark renewal touchpoint (renewal in ~5w) and request logs.
Nina (Saltwind): Start 06:00 UTC. Steady ~500 qps, spikes to 1100 for ~7-10m every half hour. They use a header `x-saltwind-key`, no mTLS. Will want token spend + suggestions on reserved capacity.
Teja (Network Ops): I need CIDR proof (whois or ticket) and the exact header name (got it). Proposed TTL for auto-revoke? Also, what's the tolerance for fallback (at 75% usage?)
Riley (Solutions): Draft push config below — please thumb if good, I'll run canary then push to prod 15m before start:
```
{
  "customer": "saltwind",
  "cidrs": ["198.51.100.16/28", "203.0.113.64/26"],
  "regions": ["ap-northeast-1", "sa-east-1"],
  "qps": 1100,
  "duration": "10h",
  "auto_revoke": "2024-09-01T16:00:00Z",
  "allow_header": "x-saltwind-key",
  "fallback_threshold_pct": 75
}
```
Teja (Network Ops): TTL OK — auto-revoke timestamp fine. We'll trigger fallback at 75% util. I'll run staging apply now. Also setting alerts: p50 > 220ms or 5xx > 0.5% -> page.
Carlos (CS): Flagging renewal as "engaged" since they're demoing under contract. I'll schedule a 30m post-demo debrief and request perf snapshot at 30m + 90m.
Nina (Saltwind): Please capture token spend and any surge patterns. If this goes well, theyre open to reserved capacity talks.
quota-bot: Quota request created: +11k tokens/hr for saltwind during window. Approve with `/approve quota 3571590000`
Carlos (CS): Approved. :white_check_mark:
Teja (Network Ops): Staging smoke: `curl -I https://proxy.tokyo.redwood/health` -> `HTTP/1.1 200 OK`. Scheduling prod cutover 15m before start (05:45 UTC).
Riley (Solutions): Canary started at 05:50 UTC, no errors in 12m. Pushing prod at 05:55 UTC. Fallback route configured to sa-east-1 with async warmup.
Teja (Network Ops): Live monitoring up — watch p50, p95, and token burn. Will post perf snapshot at 30m.
Carlos (CS): I'll record the session summary and send enablement checklist + warmup tips to Nina. Also noting renewal follow-up in 5 weeks.
Nina (Saltwind): Thanks — please also include recommended quantization profile if we suggest reserved capacity.
quota-bot: Quota change approved and active.
Teja (Network Ops): Prod live at 05:55 UTC. Monitoring window active until 07:55 UTC (first 2h watch), then keep logs for remainder. Good luck! :rocket:
